table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.purledger.purinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.purledger.date,    
	itemname    = dbo.item.name,
	supplier=dbo.accounts.name,
	quantity = dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty,
	salesman = dbo.users.username ,
	difference = dbo.purdetail.purprice -
					 (dbo.purdetail.rate/case when purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) 
												then purdetail.packunits
												else
														1
												end)
		,
	diffamount = Round(( (dbo.purdetail.purprice - dbo.purdetail.rate/(case when purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) 
																							then purdetail.packunits
																							else 1 end)) * (dbo.purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty)),2) ,
	rate = round(dbo.purdetail.rate/(case when purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) 
										then purdetail.packunits
										else 1 end),2),
	purprice=purdetail.purprice,
	itemcategory.icatcode,
	category=itemcategory.name,
	type=case when purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) 
										then 'Loose'
										else 'Pack' end

FROM
	dbo.purledger, 
	dbo.purdetail,  
	dbo.item, 
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users,
	itemcategory
WHERE
	( dbo.purledger.purinvcode = dbo.purdetail.purinvcode ) and  
	( dbo.purdetail.purprice <> Round( ( dbo.purdetail.rate/case when purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) 
												then purdetail.packunits
												else 1 end),2)) and  
	( dbo.purledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate) and 
	( dbo.purdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode ) and
	( dbo.item.icatcode IN (:ar_icatcode)) and
	( dbo.item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode) and
	( dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) and  
	( dbo.purledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) 
ORDER BY 
	dbo.itemcategory.name,
	dbo.itemcategory.icatcode,
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode,
	dbo.purledger.date,
	dbo.item.name
